A great find!!!
Sep 2023 • Friends
I found this amazing restaurant by accident when cycled around Tam Coc village. As it new opened so not many informations about. I was a bit hesitant but it turned out to be a great choice. Must to admit that was my best lunch in Tam Coc. Follow staff's suggestion I orderd Shrimp mango salad and summer roll. Foods served pretty quick and nicely presented. All the ingredients were so fresh - felt like its go direct from garden to kitchen. Moreover this restaurant located in a small, quiet alley with view to the field and I really like the elegant decoration style here. 
To sum up, if you are looking for a tasty, healthy meal this is a great place to go. But take note of they only open during day time.
